title: Difference of positive probabilities
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f,g:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$. Under the uniform distribution on the cube, write $P_+(f)$ for the probability that $f(x)=1$. Then $|P_+(f)-P_+(g)|$ is at most the probability that $f(x)\ne g(x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ and $g$ map the sign cube $\{−1,1\}^n$ to $\{−1,1\}$
